# OpenNexus 0.6.0-beta8

## 更新内容

- **连接诊断恢复**：启动检查与重新检测重叠时，只采用最后一次发起的检查结果。较早的失败响应不会把已恢复的 AI Core 显示为离线，较早的成功响应也不会掩盖当前连接故障；版本、索引、权限与错误提示跟随同一批检查更新。
- **HTTPS 证书校验**：更新 Core 的 certifi、Host 的 rustls-webpki 与根证书包，拒绝受 emSign 证书事件影响的证书链；打包使用的 uv 同步更新。依赖依据 [certifi 安全公告](https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/security/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2)和 [RustSec 公告](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0382)固定。
- **验证范围**：新增回归覆盖迟到失败、迟到成功和单次检查。修复后的 6 项相关检查通过；诊断修复只涉及结果展示，不会重发保存、登录或同步操作。

## English

- **Connection diagnostics recovery**: When startup checks overlap with another check, only the most recently requested results are applied. An earlier failure no longer marks a recovered AI Core offline, and an earlier success no longer hides a current connection failure. The version, index, permissions, and error message update from the same check.
- **HTTPS certificate validation**: Update Core's certifi, Host's rustls-webpki, and the root certificate package to reject certificate chains affected by the emSign incident. The uv version used for packaging is updated as well. Dependencies are pinned against the [certifi security advisory](https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/security/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2) and [RustSec advisory](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0382).
- **Validation scope**: New regressions cover late failures, late successes, and a single check. All 6 related checks pass after the correction. The diagnostics correction affects presentation and does not repeat save, sign-in, or sync operations.
